title: Wounded gang member dies
article: A gang member gunned down in a shootout with police after a high- speed chase died in hospital this morning.
Long Duy Hoang, 28, had been taken off life support the night before.

He was shot repeatedly by three members of the police tactical team early Wednesday evening after his Honda Accord led three cruisers on a two-minute chase reaching speeds of 100 km/h through residential west Edmonton.
The chase ended when Hoang crashed his Honda into a parked Jeep. Hoang's passenger gave himself up but Hoang reportedly stayed in the car and began firing at police while still seat-belted.

"The members fired many rounds ... There are multiple injuries on the subject and I'm not sure yet if even the medical doctors have ascertained the number of hits," Edmonton police chief John Lindsay told reporters Thursday.
Police had been looking for the Honda Wednesday after getting a tip the men inside were carrying weapons.
They are conducting an internal review of the shooting, which is mandatory whenever police fire a weapon in the line of duty.
Police said two Asian-based gangs are fighting over the city's drug trade.
